title: The collector's first live trials: Claude's priced opinion only, and real tables without an outcome recorded for their roles
request: The owner's step 2: 'the collector's first live run (10 tables, Claude capped at EUR 0.5)'; if clean, switch it on with a higher monthly cap.
spec: docs/guides/STUDENTS_100_PLAN.md S2; the owner's rules: Claude's outputs are silver and evaluation only; live runs capped and reported.
plan: Run 10 new tables with the cap.
Read the run record and the usage log, not only the run's own figures.
Fix what the trial shows, with tests; run again.

decisions.decision: Silver refuses a model that is not a priced Claude.
decisions.why: Silver is Claude's opinion by the owner's rule, and a cap binds only where a price counts the spend.

decisions.decision: The 155 mislabelled answers kept in their own file with a note, out of the file read as Claude's opinion.
decisions.why: Every record is kept; real_shadow.compare reads that file as Claude's.

decisions.decision: A table that declares no outcome is recorded for its columns' roles only, from its derived record, no download.
decisions.why: Most of OpenML's later uploads declare no outcome; their declared column types are the real truths the role student needs.

decisions.decision: Switched on: DCLAB_COLLECTOR=1 and DCLAB_COLLECTOR_MONTHLY_EUR=18 in .env.
decisions.why: The owner chose a higher monthly cap than the plan's EUR 10, about the $20 given; a run's cap stays EUR 0.5.

change: dclab_rnd/real_shadow.py (served_by, load_env, the model on each silver line, run_one's roles-only path, _tables without an outcome), dclab_rnd/collector.py (load_env; homework's bar on labelled decisions), tests/test_real_shadow.py, tests/test_collector.py.

findings.defect: The trial's silver was not Claude's and its cost was not counted.
findings.scenario: Run 1: 155 answers for EUR 0.00; the usage log names gpt-5.6-terra on api.openai.com with no price.
findings.cause: real_shadow and collector never read .env, so the shell's OpenAI key served; ModelAnswerer was named 'claude' whatever answered.
findings.fix: load_env in both command lines; served_by refuses anything but a priced Claude; each line records its model.

findings.defect: No new table was run on.
findings.scenario: Run 1: shadowed {} although 6 homework tables were gathered.
findings.cause: None of them declares an outcome and _tables required one, so they were never run, nor marked failed.
findings.fix: Roles only for a table without an outcome.

findings.defect: The run record called a point's homework met with no labels.
findings.fix: The bar counts decisions with a truth, and their tables.

measurements.name: the collector, run 3
measurements.gate: a live run capped at EUR 0.5
measurements.result: 3 homework, 1 dev and 5 sealed tables gathered, 1 copy set aside; 303 tables shadowed (6,377 decisions); 155 Claude answers (claude-sonnet-5-5) for EUR 0.3254; the exam set holds 8 of the 50 sealed tables it needs
limits: run 2 was skipped by the busy guard, as it should be
the exam set is not full yet

outcome: The collector runs nightly with Claude's capped opinion; tables without an outcome feed the role student.
lessons: Read a run's spend from the usage log, not from the run's own count: a run that does not know its model's price reports zero.
risks: The fresh exam set needs about three nights.
